lines.zh: 懒洋洋地待着，不急不躁
懒懒地待着，看起来没威胁
它伏在圣所的祭坛前，呼吸很轻。
lines.en: It lies before the sanctum altar, breathing faintly.

lines.zh: 鳞片随呼吸起伏，像睡着了。
lines.en: Its scales rise and fall as if in sleep.

lines.zh: 石台上，它把身体盘成一圈。
lines.en: On the slab it coils itself into a ring.
Now and then its tail tip twitches.

lines.zh: 祭坛的烛火映着它的背。
lines.en: The altar candles glow along its back.

lines.zh: 它把脸埋进自己的褶皱里。
lines.en: It buries its face in its own folds.

lines.zh: 獠牙在石缝间慢慢露出。
lines.en: My fangs slowly slide out of the stone seams.

lines.zh: 它抬起眼皮，只露出一道缝。
lines.en: It lifts a lid to a bare slit.

lines.zh: 它的目光从祭坛上滑到你脸上。
lines.en: Its gaze slides off the altar onto your face.

lines.zh: 它看见了你的火把，也看见了刀。
lines.en: It notes your torch and your blade alike.

lines.zh: 你踩到圣所的地砖，它睁眼。
lines.en: Your foot finds the sanctum tile, and it opens its eyes.

lines.zh: 它慢慢转头，颈骨咔咔响。
lines.en: It turns its head slowly, vertebrae crackling.

lines.zh: 它打量你，像在估一餐的分量。
lines.en: It sizes you up like a portion of a meal.

lines.zh: 我感到圣所中的黑暗在吞噬我...
lines.en: Darkness in the sanctuary feeds on me...
My fur begins to fall off...

lines.zh: 力量从我的身躯中流失...
你闻到了腐败的味道吗？

lines.en: The sanctuary candles sway with you.

lines.zh: 撞击产生的碎片四处飞溅！

lines.en: You are pushed back by my force!

lines.zh: 强烈的震荡让你摇摇欲坠！
找到我的配偶，繁衍生命！
我在圣所里坐着，等你先动手。
lines.en: I sit in the sanctuary until you strike first.

lines.zh: 在圣所中觅食时被发现。
lines.en: Discovered while foraging in the sanctuary.

lines.zh: 沉睡中被惊醒，开始警觉。
发现了你的存在，开始移动。
lines.en: Detects your presence, begins to move.
Nests in the shadows of the sanctuary.

lines.zh: 圣所中寻找食物的生物。
lines.en: Forages for food in the sanctuary.
Stays motionless, like an eternal statue.

lines.zh: 圣所的守护者，沉默而神秘。
lines.en: Guardian of the sanctuary, silent and enigmatic.

lines.zh: 骨座下的尘埃浮起来了。
lines.en: Dust rises beneath my bone throne.
You are the prey I've waited for.

lines.zh: 圣所里我睡着，打我就醒。
lines.en: I sleep in the sanctuary. Hit me and I wake.
The only threat in the sanctuary.

lines.zh: 圣所里坐着，等你先动手。
lines.en: I sit in the sanctum; you strike first.

lines.zh: 我在圣所等着，你迟早进来。
lines.en: I wait in the sanctuary. You will come in.

lines.zh: 你踏进圣所，它认定你了。
lines.en: You enter the sanctum, and it has chosen you.

lines.zh: 石座上的爪痕亮了一下。
lines.en: Claw marks on my throne flicker once.

lines.zh: 你身上的光让它彻底醒来。
lines.en: The light on you finally wakes it.

lines.zh: 它把尾巴从祭坛上垂下来。
lines.en: It slides its tail down off the altar.

lines.zh: 它开始数你身后的退路。
lines.en: It begins counting the ways behind you.

lines.zh: 圣所的门关上了，它锁定了你。
lines.en: The sanctum door shuts, and its mark is you.

lines.zh: 它撑起前身，视线压过来。
lines.en: It pushes its front half up, gaze bearing down.

lines.zh: 圣所里我坐着，等你动手。
lines.en: I sit in the sanctum, waiting for your first move.

lines.zh: 它把身体舒展开，挡在门口。
lines.en: It unfolds itself across the doorway.

lines.zh: 它绕着祭坛，一寸寸收紧。
lines.en: It circles the altar, drawing the ring tighter.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片开始渗出发黑的液体。
lines.en: Black fluid begins to seep between its scales.
Its hiss is as low as a prayer.

lines.zh: 它用尾巴拍地，一声接一声。
lines.en: Its tail strikes the floor, again and again.

lines.zh: 它把祭坛上的供品扫落。
lines.en: It sweeps the offerings off the altar.
It waits for you to move first.

lines.zh: 它把嘴张到不该有的宽度。
lines.en: Its mouth opens far wider than it should.

lines.zh: 圣所的烛火全被它压暗了。
lines.en: It smothers every candle in the sanctum.

lines.zh: 它抬起上半身，比你高出一截。
lines.en: It rears up a head taller than you.
Sssss... You dare to move me?
Fork of the Woe, I will kill you!
Wait, the harbinger of death approaches.

lines.zh: 可恶！你打扰了我的沉睡！
我的存在，让这片土地颤抖吧。
lines.en: Let this land tremble under my presence.

lines.zh: 你是下一个，我会让你感受痛苦。
lines.en: You're next, I'll let you feel pain.

lines.zh: 你动了我的领域，付出代价吧！
lines.en: You've trespassed my domain, pay the price!

lines.zh: 灾祸之源，我的力量觉醒！

lines.en: One palm slams down and cracks the tiles.

lines.zh: 它咬住你的护甲，往里拧。
lines.en: It bites your armor and twists.

lines.zh: 它用尾巴把你抽向石柱。
lines.en: Its tail whips you toward a pillar.

lines.zh: 腐液溅上你的手臂，灼痛。
lines.en: Rot splashes your arm and burns.
In the sanctuary, I will awaken.

lines.zh: 我的苏醒，是这片土地的噩梦。
lines.en: My awakening is this land's nightmare.
Woe's apprentice, I will protect it.

lines.zh: 圣所中的宁静，即将破灭。
lines.en: The sanctuary's peace is about to be shattered.

lines.zh: 这将是你的末日，灾祸将降临。
lines.en: This will be your end, woe will fall.
The sanctuary's depths, woe has awakened.
Master of woe, I will guard it.

lines.zh: 圣所深处的祭坛开始震动。
lines.en: The deep sanctum altar begins to shake.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸先响起，身体后成形。
lines.en: Its breathing comes first, then its body.

lines.zh: 石缝里渗出黑水，聚成它。
lines.en: Black water seeps from the cracks and gathers into it.
The candles gutter, and it is on the dais.

lines.zh: 圣所的守夜者换了一个。
lines.en: The sanctum has a new night watch.

lines.zh: 它从祭坛的阴影里坐起。
lines.en: It sits up out of the altar's shadow.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的风吹进圣所，它醒了。
lines.en: Bone-waste wind enters the sanctum, and it wakes.

lines.zh: 它睁开眼，圣所安静下来。
lines.en: It opens its eyes and the sanctum goes quiet.

lines.zh: 一层黑雾散开，它就在那里。
lines.en: A black mist clears, and there it is.

lines.zh: 它伏在供桌后，等你上钩。
lines.en: It lies behind the offering table, waiting.
My stone shell cracks, I'm still not awake.
The sanctuary collapses, I fall into darkness.
